title: Session 2026-11-05, checkout found down, answer engine tripled, 6 satellites live, gates, deploy pipeline fixed
verdict: URGENT. MCP checkout has been down since 2026-11-04. The Stripe CLI restricted key that the billing worker uses expired, and every $19, $39 and services buy POST returns 502 (probed once each, tagged x-mcp-probe). /health still says ok because it only checks the key prefix. The fix is the owner running stripe login, then a gated billing redeploy, which also ships PR #116 and #119. MCP revenue is still $0. Google impressions on mcpstamp.com rose to 143 a day (6 on 10-30), and question pages are the only kind ranking on page one, so this session put about 40 more honest answer pages live. There are 18 new can-Claude pages with real server calls, 3 live-data pages, 15 can-ChatGPT pages and 3 can-Cursor pages. They came from 1,491 real Google autocomplete questions. Two independent truth gates found 29 false claims in the drafts, mostly 'Claude cannot', when code execution is on by default. All were fixed before deploy, as was the same error on 10 older pages. The zip page title now answers the query directly. Three new free live-data satellites went live: UV index, FDA drug shortages, census tract. Each has a Worker, public repo, registry entry and site page, for 30 in total. Community PR #96 was merged and #97 got a review. Two awesome-list PRs were opened. Two traps were fixed. The local site tree was 22 commits stale and would have reverted production (publish.sh now refuses), and the CI artifact lacked site/lib, which failed the first production deploy. Wave 2 added 15 buyer-intent can-Claude pages for paid back-office servers (gate 95, 0 blocks), new titles on 8 pages already ranking 5 to 15, three more satellites (Social Security COLA 2027, I bond rate, mortgage rates today, 33 total), and a 14-entry outreach batch for the owner to send by hand. The 6 new satellites also got pages on claudecodeguides.com/mcp/ (PR #12, 33 of 33 live), the hub that assistants cite. Two user updates went to Zovo Chat, What's new (messages 511 and 519).
